newsitem.title: USA: Sallie Mae to redeem 6.56 pct notes.
newsitem.headline: Sallie Mae to redeem 6.56 pct notes.

text.p: Sallie Mae said on Monday it would be redeeming its 6.56 percent callable notes due August 5, 1998.

The company, formally known as the Student Loan Marketing Association, said in a statement that the security would be redeemed in its entirety on February 5, 1997. The security bears the CUSIP number 86387RSM5.
The principal and final interest payment for the 6.56 percent notes is due and payable on February 5 to holders of record at the close of business on February 4.
The notes will be repaid at 100 percent of the face amount. Accrued interest of $32.80 per $1,000 face amount will also be paid on February 5. The par amount of the notes is $100 million.
